annotation.authors_or_issuer: JDIH Kementerian Komunikasi dan Digital (Komdigi), Indonesia
key_provisions_or_claims: Komdigi is finalizing the National AI Roadmap White Paper, the basis for two draft Presidential Regulations on the AI roadmap and AI ethics.
A speaker said a vision limited to ethics and responsibility is too normative.
Proposes AI as a primary utility and Green AI Infrastructure for digital sovereignty and energy sustainability.
Calls for national standards and interoperability protocols before adopting global technologies.
The white paper is targeted for completion at the end of 2025.
annotation.summary_en: Government news item from Indonesia's Ministry of Communication and Digital on finalizing the National AI Roadmap White Paper, which will underpin two draft Presidential Regulations on AI roadmap and ethics. Participants urge digital sovereignty, Green AI infrastructure, national standards and interoperability. No robotics content.
annotation.title_clean: Buku Putih AI Nasional Disempurnakan, Tekankan Interoperabilitas dan Keberlanjutan
annotation.title_en: National AI White Paper Refined, Emphasizing Interoperability and Sustainability
